rows.en: I'd like to borrow it for a bit.
What are you going to do with a computer?
I'm going to try accessing the information bank of the TDF's main computer.
Wha… The TDF!?

Oh… You've really been through a lot. Burned out of your home by a fire…

Well, I'm sorry it's so cramped here… but make yourselves at home.

Okay, thank you very much.

We only just met, and you're being so kind to us. You're a really nice person, Mr. Tachibana.
Pulling out a cell phone… Who on earth are you calling?
A friend's older sister is a TDF communications officer. She's probably calling her.
The TDF, short for the Terrestrial Defense Force, is Earth's largest military organization, formed on a supranational level to deal with the alien invasions that have been increasing in recent years.
With its General Headquarters in Paris, the TDF had branches in Washington, Moscow, London, Berlin, Sydney, Cairo and the North Pole, and its Far East Branch in Japan.
The Far East Branch, with its secret base beneath the foot of Mt. Fuji, was a vast force led by outstanding commanders: Director Yamaoka, and Staff Officers Manabe, Yanagawa, Takenaka and Bogard.
And serving as a special unit directly under command were the elite officers chosen through rigorous tests…
Captain Kiriyama, Officer Furuhashi, Officer Amagi, Officer Soga, and Officer Anne Yuri, the only woman, who doubled as a nurse…
Licensed to operate the Defense Force's super-weapons, they were Earth's trump card against alien invasion… With respect and admiration, people called them the Ultra Garrison.

HQ, come in. Come in. This is Pointer!

Furuhashi and Soga on scheduled patrol in Tokyo's K District. Nothing unusual to report.
Roger. Officer Furuhashi, please continue your patrol.
Furuhashi, roger. Scheduled report over!
Officer Furuhashi… You're actually sick of it, aren't you?
Sick of what?
This incredibly boring scheduled patrol… sir.

You fool!!

Soga, you're slacking off! It's precisely in peaceful times that we of the Ultra Garrison must pay even closer attention to protecting the safety and peace of the citizens!!
Sir!! I-I'm sorry, sir!
…That said, it really is boring, huh? Let's wrap this up early and head back to HQ.
Sounds good…

What's this? Weird paint on their faces… Some underground theater troupe's wrap party?

He-ey, you there… Where do you think you're going at this hour?
Whoa!? These guys are attacking us!
Who are you!? Why are you attacking us?
Eeee!

Officer Furuhashi… They seriously mean to kill us!

Ah, hey, that's dangerous! You can't just charge out there like that… Of-Officer Furuhashi!!
Who in the world are these guys…?
They sure don't look like ordinary humans, but they don't seem like aliens either, do they? For now, let's contact HQ…
Eh, eh, eh, eiii, eiiiiii!!
Whoa! A m-monster!?
Ugh! It's sinking its fangs into my neck!? Waaaaagh… Officer Furuhashi!!
S-Soga!
Ugh, uuuuugh…
You monster! What did you do to Soga!?

Eh, eh, eh… He has been injected with the mind-control virus!

Any human whose blood I drink becomes a servant of Shocker. Now it's your turn!! Eiii, eiiiiii!!
Waaaaagh!!
Final protection… released. [HERO2], I've gained access to the TDF's information bank.

Whoa? That's really something…

Getting into the TDF's information bank, a big lump of classified secrets, with an old computer from a tiny shop like this?
[HERO4], is there any information?

One moment, please…

Nothing in particular at the moment, it seems. Oh…?
What is it, [HERO4]?
This may not be anything serious, but it says the scheduled report from an Ultra Garrison patrol has stopped coming in…
Couldn't they just be eating, or on a break or something?

No. An ordinary officer, maybe, but the elite Ultra Garrison would never slip up like that.

Something's going on here…
Oh, [HERO2]… For someone who just came back from space, you sure know a lot about the TDF.
Ah… no, well…
[HERO4], do you know where they lost contact?
Yes… Oh, it's surprisingly close by.
All right… Let's go take a look for now!
Yeah, so that's how it is…
Hmm… So you know a TDF communications officer, huh…
Uh, yeah…
Huh, really? Where… uh-huh, uh-huh… That's near here.
Is something wrong, [HERO4]?
She says a scheduled patrol car carrying Ultra Garrison officers stopped sending in its scheduled reports…
The Ultra Garrison?
[HERO4], the place where they lost contact is near here, right? Let's go take a look for now!
Ah, there are people over there…!?
Those uniforms… The Ultra Garrison!?
Hey, you! Are you all right?
…Gwaah!
Wh-what are you doing!
Uwaaaagh!!

Ngh… Something's wrong with these guys!?

[HERO4], run a bio-scan and check their condition!
Roger!

Either way, this is bad! We'll have to put them to sleep…

Tooh!!
Geh!
Sorry about this…
Ugh…

All right…

We managed to knock them out… Judging by these uniforms, they must be Ultra Garrison, no doubt about it. Why would they attack us?

…Scan complete.

An unknown virus has gotten into their blood.

I can't be sure without a closer look, but most likely it acts on their central nervous system, and their minds are being controlled by someone…
An unknown virus? Manipulating people?

…!?

The only ones who could do something like that… are Shocker!!
[HERO4]! Search the surrounding area! They're still somewhere nearby!
Bio-weapon detected!
All right! Let's go, Hongo!!

Ah, there's someone over there.

Could it be… the Ultra Garrison!?

uncertain: U00330: その娘 read as the person [HERO4] is phoning ('She's probably calling her'); Hongo asked who she was calling
U00331: TDF = 地球防衛軍 rendered 'Terrestrial Defense Force' (U00210 source spelled 'Defence' in Latin text; kept that there)
U00342: added 'sir' for Soga's polite ですよ to his superior
U00393: [HERO2] speaking to the unconscious Ultra Garrison officer
